verdict.rationale: Granola's docs describe meeting summaries, chat, and follow-up workflows (draft emails, Slack messages, calendar events) but nowhere document a feature that automatically extracts discrete action items with assigned owners into a trackable list/board. A community report (granola-comm-7) even shows a PM building a separate third-party app specifically because action items 'tend to slip through' native Granola notes, underscoring the absence of this capability.
